{"calls":[{"tool":"publish_release","id":null,"version":"4.0.0","notes":"# quaykit 4.0.0

This release adds a worker event for empty queues and improves Redis lock-renewal resilience. It also adds `queue.purge()` and deprecates `queue.clean()`.

## Features

- Emit `drained` when a worker finds the queue empty and has no active jobs. (#331)
- Add `queue.purge({ status, olderThanMs })` to remove older jobs. (#338)

## Fixes

- Retry Redis lock renewal after an `ECONNRESET`. (#334)

## Security

- Signing component: upgrade quaykit to this release. (#336)

## Deprecations

- Deprecate `queue.clean()` in favor of `queue.purge()`. Migrate calls from `queue.clean(graceMs, status)` to `queue.purge({ status, olderThanMs: graceMs })`. (#338)","bump":null,"sections":null},{"tool":"finish","id":null,"version":"4.0.0","notes":"# quaykit 4.0.0

## Deprecations
